name: Kougo Chiyomi
source:
She is the grandmother of a student at the cram school where Naito teaches. She takes care of her granddaughter in place of her daughter, who is busy traveling abroad. 

Her husband passed away a long time ago and she has been single for just as long. In her younger days, she was a sexually uninhibited, and a well-trained promiscuous pervert.

When she got married she took the opportunity to play the role of a chaste wife. 

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_030/character.html]official site[/url]]
